Inner Ivory Card with 'Sanidhya & Vasudha' and wedding date visible upon flap opening

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Keep the exact file path structure for JavaScript code (/app/frontend/src/components/RoyalEnvelopeHero.js).
2. Preserve the user's exact inscription 'Two Journey One Heart' on the inside flap.
3. Display 'Sanidhya & Vasudha' on the ivory insert. The correct wedding date is 10 December 2026, not the old February placeholder.
4. Preserve the approved burgundy craft paper exterior and ivory insert, with visible organic fibres and gold foil trim.
5. Use CSS 3D preserve-3d / Three.js canvas setup to handle physical perspective and realistic flap flipping animation.

6. Include required testing attributes: data-testid='envelope-scene', data-testid='envelope-open-btn', data-testid='wax-seal-open-btn', data-testid='envelope-flap-text', data-testid='envelope-inner-card'.
7. Preserve full continuity with the rest of the wedding invitation page upon trigger of onComplete().
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
Do not use transparent backgrounds without blur or background fill behind readable text.
Maintain contrast ratios (WCAG AA) with gold text over burgundy/craft paper using subtle text dropshadows.
Honor prefers-reduced-motion for instant reveal without camera motion sickness.
